text:
matt: Quick quarterly check-in — owners checklist for OKR milestones. Need a short status: what shipped, what slipped, and recovery steps. Pinging eng + product owners. TL;DR I see 3 problem areas: KV cache rollout, Dedicated Autoscaler, Console metrics backlog.

sophia: I'll start — KV cache rollout went to canary yesterday but long-tail perf didn't meet the 95th goal.

aj: Quick numbers: typical 50th down ~20% but 95th increased ~250ms in some tails. Investigating prefetch vs batching behavior.

kevin: Dedicated Autoscaler slipped — blocked by infra quota on GCP, waiting on billing SA perms from finance.

maya: Finance approved the spend yesterday, but infra needs a key rotation step before we can provision. I'll follow up with eng-infra. ETA EOW.

matt: Console metrics backlog: per-route cost breakdown missing from the dashboard. Who owns frontend/workflow for that? @sophia

sophia: That's me. We're short-staffed so full per-route got deprioritized. Can ship a rollup shim by next Tue, full per-route by EOM.

aj: For KV cache tails, quick workaround proposed: disable prefix caching for requests > 2k tokens. Deploy snippet: ```kubectl set env deploy/serving ROLLING_PREFETCH=false``` Testing now.

kevin: I'll update OKR doc to mark Autoscaler as slipped and add recovery steps. Should we include a contingency to route low-priority traffic to cheaper model when autoscaler is down?

maya: :thumbsup: I'll file an infra ticket and link it here. Ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-449

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for kv-cache-v2 on prod-canary (build 512).

sophia: Can someone sanity-check the recovery rule wording: "Canary rollback to kv-cache-v1 if 95th > 300ms for 10m" — ok?

aj: Agree. Also add automated alert: `alert.kv_cache_tail` for 95th > 300ms for 5m.

matt: Next steps: aj investigates perf (ETA 48h), sophia ships shim (ETA Tue), maya files infra ticket + rotates keys (ETA Fri), kevin updates OKR doc + adds contingency. I'll consolidate updates into the company OKR sheet.

kevin: Done — updated doc with slipped flag and recovery rows: https://docs.redwood.ai/okr/q1-milestones (added owners + dates).

sophia: Added PR for shim: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/1327 — PTAL @matt @kevin

aj: One more item: test harness logs show spikes correlated with token length > 3k. I'm adding token-length histogram to telemetry to confirm.

matt: Great. Reconvene async here if any blockers. I'll collect final notes and post EOD Friday. :calendar:

matt: Closing loop for now — thanks everyone for the quick responses. If anything slips further, drop a short update in this thread.
